test_title: SSC Selection Post Graduation Level Official Paper (Held on: 2 Aug 2022 Shift 3)
subject: general
question:
**Select the option that can be used as a one-word substitute for the given group of words.**

An arrangement of parts or elements in a particular form or figure
solution: The correct answer is "**Configuration"** ** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__** __ • The group of words in the question refers to an **arrangement of parts or elements in a particular form or figure**. • The one-word substitute for this is "**configuration**" which means the **arrangement or disposition of parts or elements in a particular form, figure, or combination**. • "**Contortion**" means a twisted or distorted shape or position. • "**Amorphousness**" means lacking a definite shape or form. • "**Delineation**" means the action of describing or portraying something precisely. Thus, ***option 2*** is the correct answer. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/51867102c7c2f369f6e29d2efe025e3b3367c68261ec20262828d84ca5c8f854.png] **Hinglish__** • "**C**onfiguration" का अर्थ है किसी विशेष रूप, आकृति या संयोजन में भागों या तत्वों की व्यवस्था या स्वभाव। • "Contortion" का अर्थ है एक मुड़ी हुई या विकृत आकृति या स्थिति। • "Amorphousness" का अर्थ है एक निश्चित आकार या रूप का अभाव। • "Delineation" का अर्थ है किसी वस्तु का सटीक वर्णन या चित्रण करने की क्रिया। 6b:T950, The correct answer is "**Rahim's house is being built rapidly**"
